deterministic_data.verification: Final Workbench assembly is 14/14 ready with zero errors and warnings, including the Factory canonical validator and the persistence check; SqliteStoreRepository carries every one of the 101 StoreRepository operations with the identical signature, plus create_store_schema; the data provider is python_constant_data_v1 from 70_data_provider_closure.json. clock is system_clock_backend/v3 (python_host_clock_v1) under rules.time_source_policy (single_host_source true), decision 26.

modules.summary: Deterministic model module: domain, operation, store-row and value models with their tagged unions, and the StoreRepository port (101 operations, kind interface) whose 101 notes the store-persistence script generates from one row table. Every port operation is carried with the identical signature by SqliteStoreRepository (implementation_obligations). Decision 24 delta reviewed (RunsByStatus.statuses, ShownEffectAttempt). Decision 32 delta reviewed (operation models of run_graph, run_values, sandbox_runner; ExecutionObservation; StoreChange variant RecordDeliveryValuesChange; every sum type discriminated).

Deterministic constant module (python_constant_data_v1) emitted from 70_data_provider_closure.json: the release ceilings of A20, token length, header sets, sandbox trap lists, manifest suffix, service-id pattern and the four MCP constants of decision 22. No rules or config address repeats a value. Decision 25 delta reviewed.

Canonical JSON (RFC 8785, ±(2^53−1)), content identity per subject with the order-free sorts of A01/A05, the supported schema subset of State 6 decision 2 and the fit order presence, carriage, schema, size are closed by 18 notes; the A01 identity witness is satisfiable from them.

Deterministic since decision 26: system_clock_backend/v3 (python_host_clock_v1) lowers kernel_now (one time.time_ns sample floored to KernelInstant.epoch_us) and monotonic_ns (one raw time.monotonic_ns sample) from rules.time_source_policy; no notes. monotonic_deadline and MonotonicDeadline withdrawn; sandbox and service_invoker derive their one deadline from a monotonic_ns reading held locally.

Emitted from 70_persistence_closure.json (persistence_backend/v3, sqlite_sync_v2, transaction external): SqliteStoreRepository carries all 101 StoreRepository operations with identical signatures plus __init__, and create_store_schema; it imports only models. No note is scoped to it, by design.

Decision 32: the inside of an execution — runner text (environment, setrlimit limits, traps by the owner of the path, audit hook and task count, load and call, pre-count, MemoryError), its two arguments (the channel's descriptor number, one JSON configuration whose members are not spelled like data symbols) and the decoding of its one-line JSON messages; both ends of the protocol in one module.

Every repository operation the store notes name exists in store_persistence; positions, minted identities, attempt numbers, relations, paging and spool ceilings match State 5 and decision 23. Repaired: files and directories the store creates are private, so the next start's A18 rule 2 check passes on the kernel's own files. Decision 24 delta reviewed (RunsByStatus.statuses, ShownEffectAttempt). Decision 25 delta reviewed. Decision 32 delta reviewed (RecordDeliveryValuesChange writes its StoredValues and nothing else).

Start checks, the four re-read checks of A16 rule 2 and per-request credential resolution are closed. Repaired from A17 rules 1-2: configuration and secret files are opened component by component without following links, checks and read use one opened file, and a secret file over bounded_text_bytes_max is credential_unresolved (the ceiling is now imported).

A03 isolation, traps, bounds and outcomes are closed. Repaired: the setrlimit process value is set above process_count (owner 2026-10-06; the audit hook enforces process_count), consistent with the next note; failure_detail's ceiling is stated positively and now imported. Decision 25 delta reviewed. Decision 26 delta reviewed (deadline from clock.monotonic_ns). Decision 32 delta reviewed: launch and supervision only — pass_fds at the parent's numbers, no dup2 or preexec_fn, the runner from sandbox_runner; judge_execution names the outcome from the observation.

Pre-send checks, request building, transport and the A09 rule 5 outcome order are closed. Repaired: a 2xx body over service_response_bytes_max is contract_violation whatever the output ports; value outputs fit with the response ceiling so value_too_large is decided by its own check (State 5); placeholders are judged in name order (A08 rule 5). Decision 26 delta reviewed (deadline from clock.monotonic_ns).

Decision 32: the only place a StoredValue for delivery comes into being — list element, mapped list built and measured before any is written, empty lists for the node's record, flow outputs; deliver_input writes in a RecordDeliveryValuesChange before fit_port_value and answers DeliveredInput | InputMisfit.

Repaired: modal clauses for 13 callables, an equal submission returns the stored record, a port named twice is refused (N07, owner-confirmed), trial refs in port order. Q1 closed by decision 24: rollback to the serving implementation returns it with nothing recorded, before the verdict check.

Manifest reading, the A08 proposal checks in order, acceptance with binding_stale, currency checks and the start check of credential headers are closed; 7 callables were given their modal clause (Factory underspec gate). The Factory slice imports the header-name constants and every model the notes build.

Composition, the nine proof phases and activation are closed against A05/A06 and their witnesses. Repaired: a constant fits its schema as fit_port_value judges it, so a schema outside the State 6 decision 2 subset fits nothing (now imported); 6 callables were given their modal clause.

Approvals, grants, sends under authority, unknown outcomes and recovery are closed against A10/A11. Repaired: records are written with record_change and times taken from kernel_now in a positive clause (clock.kernel_now was missing from imports); a fresh approval after not_applied is judged against the element's latest such attempt (A10 rule 1).

Decision 32: plan_run derives without writing every element's conclusion (operation elements from operation_element_conclusion), edges with the guard from the guard_port of the edge's own source node (M15), skip and upstream drafts, the next ready node with input sources, waits, status, produced and missing outputs.

Repaired: every run change is written through record_change with the given actor; all delivered lists of a mapped node are measured before any is delivered. Q2 closed by decision 24: recover_running_runs asks one RunsByStatus naming running, awaiting_approval and pending, answered oldest first in store order. Decision 32 delta reviewed: advance_run is the order of steps over run_graph and run_values; recover_running_runs decides each stored waiting point by operation_element_conclusion.

Repaired: in_set filters are non-empty, at most page_size_max, deduplicated and code-point ordered before page_records (State 5 question 5); a field typed X | None fits when absent or null (witnesses). Open: ShownRecords.effect_attempts is the raw EffectAttempt, whose inputs carry value_id, spool keys and file facts of personal_data values to an agent, against A07 rule 4. Q3 closed by decision 24: an effect attempt is listed as ShownEffectAttempt, its inputs through show_port_refs (A07 rule 4). Decision 25 delta reviewed.
